signUp.title: Welcome to EzFood
signUp.downloadApp: Download the App to create a client account and access your nutrition plans on the go!
signUp.disclaimer: You are entering with a nutritionist account. This account will allow you to manage your clients and their nutrition plans. If you intended to create a client account, please install the mobile app and sign up there.
signUp.otpDisclaimer: You will receive an OTP code to verify your identity. Please check your email and enter the code below. Make sure to check your spam folder if you don't see the code.

setupProfile.title: Set Up Your Profile
setupProfile.message: Press confirm to create your account and start managing your clients and their nutrition plans.
